queries.purpose: List customer IDs and names, sorted by customer ID.
queries.query:
FROM [Customer] AS Customer
ORDER BY Customer.[No.]
SELECT Customer.[No.] AS 'Customer ID', Customer.Name AS 'Customer Name'

queries.purpose: List posted general ledger lines within the required date range, sorted by posting date and unique entry number.
queries.query:
DECLARE [FromDate] TYPE date AS 'From Date' REQUIRED
DECLARE [ToDate] TYPE date AS 'To Date' REQUIRED
FROM [G/L Entry] AS Entry
WHERE Entry.[Posting Date] BETWEEN [FromDate] AND [ToDate]
ORDER BY Entry.[Posting Date], Entry.[Entry No.]
SELECT Entry.[Posting Date] AS 'Posting Date', Entry.[G/L Account No.] AS 'G/L Account', Entry.Description AS 'Description', Entry.Amount AS 'Amount'

note: Pass 'From Date' from {{FromDate}} and 'To Date' from {{ToDate}}, both required ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Both endpoints are included. Amount is signed: positive for debits and negative for credits.
